description: Remove the saved password of a connected mailbox so the assistant can no longer read or send from it. The mailbox itself and its mail are untouched. Needs confirm: true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

email.description: Mailbox address on one of the customer's own domains, e.g. info@example.com.

name: disconnect_mailbox
title: Disconnect a mailbox
